evals.name: broad-audit
evals.prompt: Can you audit the Vue components in this app (client/src) and give me a report on performance and code-reuse opportunities? I want concrete file:line references, not generic advice.
evals.expected_output: A structured report with Performance and Code Reuse sections, each finding anchored to specific file:line references, with a suggested fix per finding. Should surface at least the Dashboard.vue size issue and some cross-view duplication.

evals.name: dashboard-bloat
evals.prompt: Dashboard.vue feels huge and I think it's doing too much — can you review client/src/views/Dashboard.vue and tell me what's wrong performance-wise and where I could break it apart into composables or smaller components?
evals.expected_output: A focused report on Dashboard.vue specifically: performance findings within the file, and a concrete seam analysis for splitting it into smaller components/composables (not just 'this file is too long').

evals.name: fetch-duplication
evals.prompt: I have a hunch we're copy-pasting the same fetch/loading/error boilerplate across our views in client/src/views. Can you check and tell me where, and how bad it is?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the repeated loading/error/data-fetch scaffold across multiple view files with file:line references for each occurrence, and proposes a shared composable as the fix.
